data.narrative:
Molten Industries is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Boyd and Kevin Bush that has raised $32.9M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of nine private firms and one public company (277810.KQ) operating in the same sector and stage band, including peers such as Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Generalist AI, and Walden Robotics.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $32.9M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A progression, yielding $66M. Peer-median analysis examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.6B and a range of $1.1B to $2.0B, reflecting the heterogeneity in robotics valuations across stage and capital deployment profiles.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $56M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $858M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty: stage-progression anchors conservatively to capital deployed, while peer comparables span Seed through Series B stages, introducing stage-mixing risk. The median valuation of $858M is most defensible for a Series A firm relative to the peer set, though calibration hinges on whether Molten Industries more closely tracks the lower-stage profiles (Humanoid at $1.4B, Walden at $1.1B) or higher-stage maturity. Additional revenue, runway, and technical differentiation data would sharpen this range.
